4 scenarios (linear, ReLU, square, and sigmoid)
4 prediction model combinations (BLUP-BLUP, BLUP-RF, RF-BLUP, and RF-RF). 
3 scenarios

(i) Proxy-omics model (\(\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B}_{\text{pred}}\), blue), 
(ii) Observed-omics model (\(\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B}\), orange), 
(iii) None-omics model (\(\mathbf{A}\), gray). 


Wilcoxon signed-rank test (one-sided, paired samples), with significance levels noted in the plot: * \(p < 0.05\), ** \(p < 0.01\).

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
# 4パターンのフォルダと凡例ラベルを対応づけ
pairs <- list(
  "out/TSS/ite_abpred/rf"   = "RF-RF",
  "out/TSS/ite_abpred/BLUP" = "BLUP-BLUP",
  "out/TSS/ite_abpred/r2b"  = "RF-BLUP",
  "out/TSS/ite_abpred/b2rf" = "BLUP-RF"
)

# A（single）側が常にsingleBLUPならこのまま
base_fol_single <- "out/TSS/ite_abpred/singleBLUP/"

for (k in seq_along(pairs)) {
  base_fol <- names(pairs)[k]
  pair_lab <- unname(pairs[[k]])

  par(mfrow = c(2, 2), pty = "s")
  for (model in c("linear", "relu", "p2", "sigmoid")) {

    # 例: .../linearcor10{n}{a}{b}{c}{d}{e}
    cvv_yos <- readRDS(paste0(base_fol, "/", model, "cor10", n, a, b, c, d, e))

    cvv_single <- readRDS(paste0(base_fol_single, model, "_cvv.rds"))
    colnames(cvv_single) <- "sB"

    mat <- cbind(cvv_yos[, 2], cvv_yos[, 1], cvv_single)
    colnames(mat) <- c("(i) AB_proxy", "(ii) AB_observed", "(iii) A")
    
    if (model == "p2"){
      model<-"square"
    }

    boxplot(
      mat,
      main = paste0("C prediction (", pair_lab, "): ", model)
    )
  }
}
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
library(tidyverse)


pairs <- list(
  "out/TSS/ite_abpred/rf"   = "RF-RF",
  "out/TSS/ite_abpred/BLUP" = "BLUP-BLUP",
  "out/TSS/ite_abpred/r2b"  = "RF-BLUP",
  "out/TSS/ite_abpred/b2rf" = "BLUP-RF"
)
models <- c("linear", "relu", "p2", "sigmoid")
base_fol_single <- "out/TSS/ite_abpred/singleBLUP/"

df_all <- list()

for (k in seq_along(pairs)) {
  base_fol <- names(pairs)[k]
  pair_lab <- unname(pairs[[k]])
  
  for (model in models) {
    cvv_yos <- readRDS(paste0(base_fol, "/", model, "cor10", n, a, b, c, d, e))
    cvv_single <- readRDS(paste0(base_fol_single, model, "_cvv.rds"))
    colnames(cvv_single) <- "sB"
    
    mat <- cbind(cvv_yos[,2], cvv_yos[,1], cvv_single)
    colnames(mat) <- c("(i) AB_proxy", "(ii) AB_observed", "(iii) A")
    
    disp_model <- if (model == "p2") "square" else model
    
    df_tmp <- as.data.frame(mat) %>%
      mutate(pair = pair_lab,
             model = disp_model)
    
    df_all[[length(df_all)+1]] <- df_tmp
  }
}

df_all <- bind_rows(df_all) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("(i) AB_proxy", "(ii) AB_observed", "(iii) A"),
               names_to = "type", values_to = "value")


df_all$type <- factor(df_all$type,
                      levels = c("(i) AB_proxy", "(ii) AB_observed", "(iii) A"))
df_all$model <- factor(df_all$model,
                       levels = c("linear", "relu", "square", "sigmoid"))


ggplot(df_all, aes(x = type, y = value, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_grid(pair ~ model) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face="bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "(i) AB_proxy"   = "#1f77b4", 
    "(ii) AB_observed" = "#ff7f0e", 
    "(iii) A"        = "grey70"   
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "C prediction across pairs and models",
    x = "",
    y = "COR"
  )


```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)

#definition
comparisons_list <- list(
  c("(i) AB_proxy",     "(ii) AB_observed"),
  c("(i) AB_proxy",     "(iii) A"),
  c("(ii) AB_observed", "(iii) A")
)

# NA removed
df_all_clean <- df_all %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))

# Wilcoxon（oneside：greater、= group1 > group2）
stat_res <- df_all_clean %>%
  group_by(pair, model) %>%
  wilcox_test(value ~ type,
              paired = TRUE,
              comparisons = comparisons_list,
              alternative = "greater") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = dplyr::case_when(
      p < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"          
    )
  )


ymax_by_facet <- df_all_clean %>%
  group_by(pair, model) %>%
  summarise(ymax = max(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

stat_res$p.adj.signif <-stat_res$p_label

stat_res_plot <- stat_res %>%
  left_join(ymax_by_facet, by = c("pair", "model")) %>%
  group_by(pair, model) %>%
  arrange(group1, group2, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(y.position = ymax + 0.05 + 0.05 * (row_number() - 1)) %>%
  ungroup()


p <- ggplot(df_all_clean, aes(x = type, y = value, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_grid(pair ~ model) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face="bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "(i) AB_proxy"     = "#1f77b4",
    "(ii) AB_observed" = "#ff7f0e",
    "(iii) A"          = "grey70"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "C prediction across pairs and models",
    x = "",
    y = "COR",
    subtitle = "Wilcoxon signed-rank test (one-sided). Significance: * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01"
  ) +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_res_plot,
    label        = "p_label",      # "*", "**", "ns"
    y.position   = "y.position",
    xmin         = "group1",
    xmax         = "group2",
    tip.length   = 0.01,
    bracket.size = 0.4,
    size         = 3,
    hide.ns      = TRUE            # "ns" not shown
  )

p
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(xtable)


sig_mark <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "",
         ifelse(p < 0.01, "**",
                ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", "")))
}

fmt_p_tex <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p >= 1e-3) return(sprintf("%.3f", p))
  expo <- floor(log10(p))
  mant <- p / (10^expo)
  paste0(sprintf("%.2f", mant), "$\\times$10$^{", expo, "}$")
}


make_cell <- function(p) {
  lab <- sig_mark(p)
  paste0(fmt_p_tex(p), ifelse(lab == "", "", paste0("\\,", lab)))
}

# --- (i) vs (ii), (i) vs (iii) 
sig_wide <- sigsum %>%
  dplyr::filter(group1 == "(i) AB_proxy",
                group2 %in% c("(ii) AB_observed", "(iii) A")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(comp = ifelse(group2 == "(ii) AB_observed",
                              "(i) vs (ii)", "(i) vs (iii)")) %>%
  dplyr::select(pair, model, comp, p) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = comp, values_from = p)

sig_wide <- sig_wide %>%
  arrange(pair, model) %>%
  mutate(
    `(i) vs (ii)`  = vapply(`(i) vs (ii)`,  make_cell, character(1)),
    `(i) vs (iii)` = vapply(`(i) vs (iii)`, make_cell, character(1))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Scenario = pair, Model = model)

print(
  xtable(sig_wide,
         caption = "Wilcoxon signed-rank test (one-sided, (i)<(ii), (i)<(iii))",
         label = "tab:signif"),
  include.rownames = FALSE,
  sanitize.text.function = identity,  # TeX記法をそのまま出力
  booktabs = TRUE
)
```
